title: Refund and free trial
subject: Re: {original_subject}
body:
Hi{from_name_greeting},

Thanks for writing about your trial or a refund.

Subscriptions and refunds are handled by Apple through the App Store. You can manage or cancel your subscription under Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions. For a refund request, Apple's reportaproblem.apple.com page is the usual path.

If you were charged after a trial and did not intend to continue, cancelling in Subscriptions stops future renewals. Apple decides refund eligibility on their side.

If you tell us what happened (dates help), we can note it on our end even though Apple processes the payment.

Kind regards,
Ben support
